result_text:
I fixed the "past 90d" block so it shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. It was displaying the 180-day figure.

The fix is one word in `addActiveRepositoriesInfoBlocks` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, around line 925. The LOC text now uses `loc90Days` instead of `loc180Days`. The repository count and percentage already used the 90-day values, so the block is now consistent.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for this block. I also haven't rendered the report to check the figures.
